title: Shardwise golden-signal orchestrator and admit_score mapping for regional SLO debugging
creator: Aisha Moreno
description:
Problem: We lack a unified way to correlate shard-level golden signals (QPS, error rate, p50/p95/p99 latency) with the admission controller's admit_score and downstream circuit-breaker state across regions. When regional failover or load-shedding occurs, on-call must stitch together traces, KV cache hit ratios, and per-token latency distributions to determine whether to adjust SLO thresholds or rollback a rollout.

Goal: Implement a Shardwise Golden-Signal Orchestrator that emits per-shard/per-route metrics plus an admit_score histogram, wires those signals into a new regional SLO debugger dashboard, and adds synthetic probes that exercise path variants (cache hit/miss, short/long sequences) to provide deterministic baselines for debugging. The artifact should make it quick to answer: is the degradation from admission policy, a decode regression, KV cache eviction, or region/network instability?
acceptance_criteria: Per-shard metrics emitted: shard_id, route, token_class (user/system/assistant), p50/p95/p99, QPS, error_rate, kv_cache_hit_rate
admit_score metric produced as histogram and 95th percentile gauge for each priority class and route
Synthetic probe jobs running in each region producing tagged samples (cache_hit=true/false, seq_len_bucket) with clear baselines
Regional SLO debugger dashboard created with panels that correlate admit_score trends, circuit-breaker states, and token-level latency breakdowns
Alert rules for sustained admit_score degradation (p95 admit_score drop > 20% for 5m) and kv_cache_hit_rate regressions linked to playbook
Runbook updated with triage steps and guided commands to fetch relevant shards, synthetic probe runs, and quick mitigations
Integration tests that validate metric labels and a test harness that can simulate a 10% injected latency to confirm dashboard attribution
implementation_steps: Design metric schema and label set (eng review): shard_id, region, route, priority, token_class, kernel_variant
Add instrumentation to admission controller to emit admit_score histogram and per-decision tags
Extend runtime telemetry to include shard-level latency buckets keyed by token_class
Create synthetic probe jobs (k8s CronJob) per-region with configurable scenarios: warm-KV, cold-KV, short/long sequences
Build Grafana dashboard: panels for admit_score heatmap, shard p99 decomposition, synthetic baseline overlay, circuit-breaker timeline
Create SLO debugger workflow in Console (link to dashboard, run synthetic probe, suggest rollback/fallback actions)
Alerting: add Prometheus rules and paged escalation for region-leader and on-call
Run end-to-end validation (dev/staging), iterate on labels and performance impact, roll out to canary region
dashboards: Shard SLO Debugger — admit_score vs p95 latency (per-route, per-priority)
Admit Score Heatmap — regions x time with priority banding
Synthetic Probe Baselines — cache_hit vs miss overlays, sequence-length buckets
Circuit State Timeline — circuit open/close events with correlated QPS and error spikes
KV Cache Health — per-shard kv_cache_hit_rate and eviction rate
alerts: REGION_ADMIT_SCORE_DROP_P95 — fires when p95 admit_score drops >20% vs baseline for 5m
KV_CACHE_REGRESSION — kv_cache_hit_rate decreases by >15% sustained for 10m
SHARD_P99_SPIKE — any shard p99 latency increases >2x baseline for 3m
CIRCUIT_OPEN_PERSISTENT — circuit for a shard remains open >2m and QPS shifted to fallback
